patterns.name: Runaway loop
patterns.description: The agent retries or repeats a purchase. One intent, many payments. Often a bug, not an attack, and just as expensive.
signals: Many payment.settled events to the same payee with the same payment.amount in a short window
One instruction.hash behind all of them

patterns.name: Scope drift
patterns.description: The agent slowly buys outside its job.
signals: payee.mcc, payment.category, payee or payment.rail not used by this agent in 30 days, repeated within 24 hours
Share of payments covered by a valid mandate falls

patterns.name: Prompt injection
patterns.description: Instructions hidden in a web page, email or document steer the agent's payments to someone else.
signals: New payee for the agent and the organization
Amount above the agent's normal range
Payee does not match what the instruction was about

patterns.name: Payee swap
patterns.description: Payment details are changed mid-flow, so a legitimate purchase lands in an attacker's account.
signals: payee differs from the payee in the checkout or payment mandate in evidence[]
Payee wallet or account first seen recently
Payee not among the agent's known suppliers

patterns.name: Agent impersonation
patterns.description: A rogue agent presents stolen credentials or tokens and passes as a trusted one.
signals: Network proof in evidence[] missing, expired or not verifying
Sudden change in agent.framework, agent.version or rail mix

patterns.name: Mandate splitting
patterns.description: A large spend broken into payments that each sit just under the limit.
signals: Several payments near the per-payment limit to the same or related payees in a short window
Cumulative spend across merchants and rails above the mandate budget
